articles.summary: Shore Bancshares, Inc. (Nasdaq: SHBI), the parent company of Shore United Bank, N.A. announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.14 per share, payable on September 16, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on September 2, 2026. Shore Bancshares Information Shore Bancshares is a financial holding company headquartered in Easton, Maryland and is the parent company of Shore United Bank, N.A. Shore Bancshares engages in trust and wealth management services through Wye Financial Partners, a division of Shore United Bank, N.A. Additional information is available at www.shorebancshares.com .
